findings.title: Dry-run symlinks can mutate real files
findings.description: The sandbox preserves symlinks, but the installer follows them. For example, an absolute `.github/prompts` symlink remains pointed at its original directory; Copilot’s `removeGeneratedPromptFiles()` then deletes marked prompt files there during `--dry-run`. Directory symlinks can likewise redirect writes outside the sandbox. Reject escaping symlinks or copy their contents into isolated sandbox paths, and add regression tests verifying original files remain untouched.

findings.title: Aborted dry runs discard the diagnostic explaining failure
findings.description: Buffered diagnostics are replayed only after `install()` returns. If it throws `InstallAbort`, such as for missing rules or broken managed markers, its stdout error messages are discarded. `installIde()` then returns exit code 1 without reporting the abort reason, leaving the command’s generic “Check the output above” message without useful details. Flush buffered diagnostics on failure before propagating the exception; extend the existing abort test to assert the diagnostic appears.
